description: Payload Attack Check — Offline WAF-style screen of one untrusted string (form field, URL, query string, header, JSON value or LLM prompt). Decodes URL/double-URL, HTML entities, JS escapes, base64 and Log4Shell obfuscation, then checks SQL injection, XSS, path traversal, command injection, SSRF (cloud metadata, private hosts), JNDI/Log4Shell, SSTI, XXE, CRLF header injection, NoSQL/LDAP injection, open redirect, prototype pollution, prompt injection and encoding evasion. Returns verdict BLOCK/SUSPICIOUS/CLEAN, 0-100 score, each finding with severity and matched snippet, the decoding layers, and fix advice. Param: text= (max 20000 chars). Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: security_payload_check
